subject: Forecast reconciliation sprint + checklist and training invite
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: lena.ortiz@acmecorp.com
Date: Wed, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast reconciliation sprint + checklist and training invite

Team —

We need a short, focused reconciliation sprint to tighten forecast definitions for Q4 (Commit / Best Case / Pipeline) and run a ~30-min training on the updated checklist. Goal: reduce ambiguity in commit signals and make sure sales and finance are aligned before the October rollup.

Proposed plan (week of Sept 20):
- Pre-work: each AE updates top 10 opportunities with a one-line justification for current stage (Commit/Best Case/Pipeline) in the shared checklist. Due: Tue Sept 21 EOD.
- Live session: 30-min training + 30-min spot-checks (we'll review 8–10 live deals). Wed Sept 22 10:00–11:00 PT.
- Post: 48h follow-up for corrections; final reconciliation updated in HubSpot.

Attached: forecast-recon-checklist.xlsx (template) and training-slides-forecast-recon.pdf. Please review the checklist before the session — it has concrete examples and a short rubric for Commit vs Best Case.

Action items for recipients:
- Marissa: drive attendee list and make sure all AEs have access to the spreadsheet.
- Karthik: can you coordinate with Solutions on one example for the training?
- Vivek: can you confirm the finance reconciliation query I should run post-session?
- Laura: ops support for HubSpot tags and reporting.

If the time conflicts, propose an alternate slot by EOD Friday. If you want to invite any customer contacts for alignment, note them here — I've CC'd Lena at ACME as a potential joint session if their leadership wants to align.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Agree this is high ROI. A couple of requests from the finance side before the session:

- Please ensure every deal row includes: current ARR, close probability (AE stated), primary blocker, and the last-touch date. That will let me run a quick cohort reconciliation and spot the largest gaps.
- I'll attach the reconciliation query and an excerpt of the ledger I plan to use for the workshop. If anyone needs sample output to test against, ping me.
- For Commit vs Best Case, let's adopt the following quick rule for the session: Commit = signed PO or explicit verbal exec approval + no material technical blocker; Best Case = exec interest + procurement/contracting in progress. We'll walk example cases in the training.

Linking the HubSpot view here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/lists/HS-234789 — use this as the canonical dataset during the sprint.
